label: D2 after a1 led rarely to S2, following an unrewarded trial, late in the episode (policy logit leaning a1 by > 4)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when every one of these input conditions holds: the agent chose a1, the transition was rare (S2 shown), and the previous trial was unrewarded (D2 with a1->S2 and prev_reward==0 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.17). It is also restricted to episode trials 50-99, mostly 60-89, and never fires before trial 50 (precision rises to 0.32). Most of the remaining selectivity comes from the model state itself: the D2 policy logit a1-a2 is above about 4 (with that, dev F1 is 0.82 and mass recall 0.99), and about 60% of activations fall in the narrow band 4 < choice <= 4.5. So this is a model readout threshold, not a clean task variable. Every variable used is observed at D2. It never fires at D1/GO, after a2, after common transitions, or after a rewarded previous trial. I did not check what modulates magnitude. The predicate uses no future variables, and the dependence on episode time is unexplained.
